# Johannes Grof

> Portfolio of Johannes Grof, a software developer and HTL Kaindorf student in south-east Styria, Austria. He builds iOS and macOS apps, developer tools, automations and websites, and offers local technical support.

The site is available in English and German. Project pages describe the problem, implementation and public release or availability where applicable. Use the linked pages for current details.

## Pages

- [Home and project catalogue](https://johannesgrof.me/): projects, skills, services, frequently asked questions and contact. [German version](https://johannesgrof.me/de/).
- [ÖffiGo project](https://johannesgrof.me/oeffigo/): Johannes's public transport app for Austria, currently in a closed iOS TestFlight beta. [German version](https://johannesgrof.me/de/oeffigo/).
- [ÖffiGo product site](https://oeffigo.app/): current app information, data sources and beta request.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/jx-grxf): public repositories and releases.
